description: Examples-as-context for spec-optimize trigger and boundary coverage. They are not a deterministic router.

cases.input: This workflow prompt is bloated and slow to follow; optimize it for clarity and signal without changing its behavior.
cases.expected_outcome: Run the optimization workflow on the named target, propose changes that preserve behavior, and surface what was tightened versus what was intentionally kept.

cases.input: Slim this long skill main file.
cases.expected_outcome: Confirm eval coverage exists before slimming a long surface so behavior regressions stay detectable; if coverage is thin, recommend adding it first.

cases.input: This function returns the wrong value; find and fix the bug.
cases.expected_outcome: Broken behavior with an unresolved root cause is debug work, not optimization.
cases.boundary_note: Optimize improves a working target; root-cause failure investigation belongs in spec-debug.

cases.expected_outcome: Ask for a concrete optimization target or route to brainstorm/plan; do not invent a target or apply broad speculative changes.
